issue.body: ### Structure of 3PI Support The implementation of 3PI support is organized as follows: 1. Base external account credentials class [#24208] 2. Subclasses to base external account credentials a. url-sourced credentials [#24411] b. file-sourced credentials [#24526] c-prerequisites. utility to sign Aws requests [#24618] c. aws-sourced credentials [#24733] 3. Internal and public apis [This PR] ### Description of this PR This PR adds - the implicit flow (load credentials via google_default_credentials()) - the explicit flow (load credentials via c core or cpp apis) Design doc: go/grpc-3pi (Google internal) @markdroth Please take a look and let me know if you have any questions. Thanks! --- This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/grpc/grpc/24814)

issue.body:
This was originally added back in https://github.com/grpc/grpc/pull/12210 to make sure that `run_tests.py`-generated timeouts would kill all test child processes and not leave zombies in our test workers.

Now that we use bazel RBE for all C/C++ tests (and all tests run in their own container), this cleanup mechanism shouldn't be necessary.
